Ruling on Motion to Dismiss Securities Class Action Complaint As previously disclosed, a putative securities class action complaint (captioned John Liggett, Sr., et al. v. C3 AI, Inc., et al. , No. 3:25-cv-07129-TLT) was filed on August 22, 2025, in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California against C3.ai, Inc. (the “Company”) and certain of its officers. On July 14, 2026, the Court granted defendants’ motion to dismiss the complaint in its entirety. The Court dismissed every cause of action.
